WITH store_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 5
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 4
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 3
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 2
            WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1
        END AS bucket_id,
        COUNT(*) AS bucket_count,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE (ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40)
       OR (ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
    GROUP BY bucket_id
), bucket_values AS (
    SELECT
        1 AS r_reason_sk,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN bucket_count END) AS cnt1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS ext1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 1 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS net1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN bucket_count END) AS cnt2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS ext2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 2 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS net2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN bucket_count END) AS cnt3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS ext3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 3 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS net3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN bucket_count END) AS cnt4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS ext4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 4 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS net4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN bucket_count END) AS cnt5,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN avg_ext_tax END) AS ext5,
        MAX(CASE WHEN bucket_id = 5 THEN avg_net_paid_inc_tax END) AS net5
    FROM store_buckets
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN v.cnt1 > 1071 THEN v.ext1 ELSE v.net1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN v.cnt2 > 39161 THEN v.ext2 ELSE v.net2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN v.cnt3 > 29434 THEN v.ext3 ELSE v.net3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN v.cnt4 > 6568 THEN v.ext4 ELSE v.net4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN v.cnt5 > 21216 THEN v.ext5 ELSE v.net5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN bucket_values AS v ON reason.r_reason_sk = v.r_reason_sk
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
